title: Точная профессиональная критика
description: Точная профессиональная критика: разбираем конструкцию и её смысл на примерах, в диалоге и авторском тексте без аудирования.
objectives: Отличать поддержку пилота от одобрения полного внедрения
notes: Критика может относиться к утверждению, а не к личности: The estimate requires justification вместо You are careless.
Would benefit from предлагает улучшение, не объявляя полную непригодность; существенное требование безопасности нельзя скрывать вежливым смягчением.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: The proposal would benefit ___ a clearer explanation of maintenance costs.
exercises.explanation: Устойчивое выражение benefit from указывает, какое улучшение было бы полезно.

exercises.prompt: Вставь подходящее слово из пары: substantiated / substantiating.
exercises.editorial_answer: The projected saving remains insufficiently substantiated.
exercises.explanation: После remains нужна характеристика утверждения: insufficiently substantiated.
Критика относится к оценке, не приписывая автору личных недостатков.

exercises.prompt: Исправь только ошибку в конструкции, сохраняя остальные слова и смысл.

public_payload.sentence: The plan would benefit of a clearer risk assessment.

accepted: The plan would benefit from a clearer risk assessment.

exercises.reference_answer: The plan would benefit from a clearer risk assessment.
exercises.incorrect_answer: The plan would benefit of a clearer risk assessment.
exercises.editorial_answer: The plan would benefit from a clearer risk assessment.
exercises.explanation: В этом значении нужно benefit from, а не benefit of.

public_payload.passage: During a design review, an engineer wrote that a proposal was “optimistic”. The project manager initially read this as a dismissive judgement of the whole team. In a follow-up note, the engineer specified that the projected savings excluded maintenance costs and depended on an untested assumption about demand. She supported a small pilot but did not recommend full implementation on the evidence available. The clarification made the disagreement actionable: the team could revise the calculation and test the assumption. It also preserved the distinction between questioning a forecast and questioning the competence or intentions of the people who had prepared it.

options.label: Abandoning any attempt to revise the calculation.
A small pilot, rather than full implementation.
Immediate full implementation without further evidence.

exercises.editorial_answer: A small pilot, rather than full implementation.
exercises.explanation: Поддержка пилота не равна поддержке немедленного полномасштабного внедрения.

public_payload.passage: During a design review, an engineer wrote that a proposal was “optimistic”. The project manager initially read this as a dismissive judgement of the whole team. In a follow-up note, the engineer specified that the projected savings excluded maintenance costs and depended on an untested assumption about demand. She supported a small pilot but did not recommend full implementation on the evidence available. The clarification made the disagreement actionable: the team could revise the calculation and test the assumption. It also preserved the distinction between questioning a forecast and questioning the competence or intentions of the people who had prepared it.

options.label: It identified omissions and an assumption that could be checked.
It proved that the team had dishonest intentions.
It removed every disagreement about future demand.

exercises.editorial_answer: It identified omissions and an assumption that could be checked.
exercises.explanation: Указаны проверяемые элементы расчёта; личная нечестность не устанавливается.

exercises.prompt: Выбери конструктивный запрос к основанию оценки.

lines.speaker: Собеседник
lines.text: Which reply challenges the claim without attacking its author?

options.label: Your intention must have been to mislead us.
Could you explain how the estimate accounts for maintenance?
Only an incompetent person would produce that estimate.

exercises.editorial_answer: Could you explain how the estimate accounts for maintenance?
exercises.explanation: Вопрос о методе расчёта проверяем; два других варианта приписывают личные качества и намерения.

public_payload.sentence: A proposal that can realistically be carried out is ___.

exercises.explanation: Feasible означает осуществимый, а не безошибочный или относящийся к прошлому.
